enchantments.tooltip: Quality Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Strength.
Doublestrike 15%: Passive: 15% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Insightful Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Evil Absorption +22%: Passive: 22% Enhancement Bonus to Evil Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
